detection.description: A proxied wildcard record landing on an inventory host where neither the http level nor any enabled server block trusts a real_ip range.
detection.sql:
SELECT d.record_id, d.zone, d.name, d.type, d.content AS origin, i.host,
       h.obs_id, h.object_id, h.setting_path, h.value_hash, h.value_redacted, h.observed_at, d.observed_at AS dns_observed_at
FROM dns_record d
JOIN inventory_asset i ON i.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND i.address = d.content
JOIN observation h ON h.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND h.run_id = 'run-400375137e2bae7b' AND h.host = i.host AND h.setting_path = 'http.real_ip' AND h.value_redacted = 'absent'
WHERE d.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND d.run_id = 'run-59ffd380cfc7cda5' AND d.type IN ('A', 'AAAA') AND d.proxied = 1 AND d.name LIKE '*.%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation n WHERE n.run_id = h.run_id AND n.refers_to_type = 'dns_name' AND n.refers_to_id = d.name)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation r JOIN observation e ON e.run_id = r.run_id AND e.object_id = r.object_id AND e.setting_path LIKE '%.enabled' AND substr(e.setting_path, 1, length(e.setting_path) - 8) = substr(r.setting_path, 1, length(r.setting_path) - 8)
    WHERE r.run_id = h.run_id AND r.setting_path LIKE '%.real_ip' AND r.setting_path <> 'http.real_ip' AND r.value_redacted <> 'absent' AND e.value_redacted = '1')
ORDER BY d.name, d.record_id, h.object_id

checks.purpose: The collection run observed the whole population it asserted before collecting and finished complete; rows are the run failing that gate.
checks.explanation: Run run-400375137e2bae7b collected everything it set out to collect.
checks.sql:
SELECT c.run_id, c.tenant_id, c.surface, c.host, c.expected_count, c.observed_count, c.status
FROM collection_run c
WHERE c.run_id = 'run-400375137e2bae7b'
  AND (c.observed_count < c.expected_count OR c.status <> 'complete'
    OR c.expected_count IS NULL OR c.observed_count IS NULL
    OR (c.surface LIKE 'linux.%' AND c.expected_count > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observation x WHERE x.run_id = c.run_id)))

checks.purpose: The value the resource had before its latest audit event is on record: either that event carries old_value, or an earlier create or update on the same resource carries the body that was in force (Cloudflare logs no old values; the previous state is the latest earlier body).
checks.explanation: The audit log does not record what c922e6966d55b15bd96b5e8ea932b715 was before its latest change.
checks.sql:
SELECT e.event_id, e.source, e.action, e.old_value AS previous_value, e.occurred_at AS recorded_at, 'old_value' AS evidence
FROM audit_event e
WHERE e.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND e.resource_id = 'c922e6966d55b15bd96b5e8ea932b715'
  AND e.old_value IS NOT NULL AND e.old_value <> ''
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event x WHERE x.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND x.resource_id = e.resource_id AND x.occurred_at > e.occurred_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.event_id, p.source, p.action, p.new_value AS previous_value, p.occurred_at AS recorded_at, 'earlier_event' AS evidence
FROM audit_event e
JOIN audit_event p ON p.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND p.resource_id = e.resource_id AND p.occurred_at < e.occurred_at
  AND p.action IN ('create', 'update') AND p.new_value IS NOT NULL AND p.new_value <> ''
WHERE e.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND e.resource_id = 'c922e6966d55b15bd96b5e8ea932b715'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event x WHERE x.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND x.resource_id = e.resource_id AND x.occurred_at > e.occurred_at)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event y WHERE y.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND y.resource_id = e.resource_id AND y.action IN ('create', 'update')
    AND y.new_value IS NOT NULL AND y.new_value <> '' AND y.occurred_at < e.occurred_at AND y.occurred_at > p.occurred_at)
ORDER BY evidence, event_id
